decisive_spans.text: Admission CT: Right pneumothorax with interval progression of aspergilloma and suspected bronchopleural fistula
Aspergillus niger isolated from right middle and lower lobe samples
degenerated hyphae on Grocott methenamine silver stain

response.rationale: D4 is supported by progressive dyspnea, fatigue, and weight loss, Aspergillus IgG >200 mg/L, Aspergillus niger isolated from BAL, degenerated hyphae on Grocott methenamine silver stain, and progressive central cavitation. D2 is also strongly supported by many of the same findings, but the presence of progressive central cavitation and degenerated hyphae on Grocott methenamine silver stain points more towards invasive aspergillosis. The negative galactomannan index is a contradiction for both, but does not rule them out.
